newsitem.title: GERMANY: German June Ifo business climate index rises again.
newsitem.headline: German June Ifo business climate index rises again.

text.p: German's Ifo economic research institute said on Friday that its business climate index for west Germany rose beyond market expectations in June to 96.0 from a revised 95.4 in May.
In east Germany, the business climate reading eased back slightly with the index at 103.6 from an upward revised 103.7 in May, Ifo said.

Business conditions improved in west Germany over the month, with the index rising to 88.9 from a revised 87.3 in May, but the expectations of businesses were scaled back slightly, falling to a reading of 103.7 from 104.1 in May.
